prompts.bunk_bed:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE complete standalone 2D prison furnishing sprite, original hand-painted comedy escape game.
Reference roles: image 1 is the existing project crate, reference ONLY for brush texture, warm muted palette and dark ink contour. Image 2 is the approved scene concept, reference ONLY for camera and material consistency. Do not include elements from either reference besides the requested furnishing.
Camera: fixed mild overhead/front 2.5D projection with NO horizontal skew: image x is world x, image y is world y; all transverse rails/edges horizontal, long depth edges straight vertical, front face below top face. Axis-aligned rectangle silhouette, no 45-degree diamond/isometric angle, no three-quarter side rotation, no vanishing-point scene. Show the top plane above a modest front elevation, with clearly planted base/feet.
Medium: handmade brush-painted warm cream, dusty sage steel, subdued ochre wood, charcoal dark contours, two main values and subtle paper wear. Lighting top-left, no glossy photoreal highlights. Detail simple enough to read at game scale.
Background: genuine transparent RGBA, ample transparent margin on all four canvas edges. NO floor, wall, backdrop, ground plane, cast shadow, soft ground oval, baked glow, tile grid, perspective guides or floating bits. Internal surface shading is allowed. No characters, text, letters, numbers, signage, logos, watermarks, pickup/skill markers or UI. Entire prop and all feet visible, exactly one unit.
Subject: compact prison TWO-TIER bunk bed. Its long bed axis runs straight VERTICALLY in the image, head at the TOP and foot at BOTTOM. Dark muted sage metal frame, two beds stacked vertically, pale worn cream mattresses, one folded gray-green blanket on each, small cream pillows at the head. Top mattress is a clear rectangular top plane (110 world units wide by 150 deep), not a diagonal trapezoid. Four upright posts, short simple right-side ladder contained within the footprint. Lower bunk peeks out at the foot. No bedding hanging outside, no accessories. Maximum visual lift above its floor footprint about 75 world units; compact rather than towering.
Composition: portrait 4:5-ish canvas, full isolated bed centered with margins. The base footprint remains one upright axis-aligned rectangle, south contact line horizontal.
